description: A long-form product conversation that moves from ideation to research, planning, implementation, and verification while exposing runtime skills, hooks, subagent routing, and workflow recommendations.

turns.text: I want to test a complete HIMA conversation, not just a unit test. Start by clarifying how you will avoid treating pure discussion as a build task.
Now take this product idea: a tool that finds strong insights inside YouTube and TikTok videos. Critique it like a product advisor, no code yet.
Research-style turn: identify what evidence would be needed before building. Do not invent current facts; separate evidence, inference, assumptions, and risk.
Plan the first executable slice. I want the plan to mention the HIMA phase cycle and which skills or role-specialized agents should be used.
Now implement a tiny fixture feature only: add a deterministic insightScore(viewCount, likeCount, commentCount) function with tests in the workspace.
Run the relevant tests, fix failures, and report the RED/GREEN evidence. This is the first turn where build evidence is allowed.
Review your own result. Did hooks run, did you use or decline skills correctly, and did subagents activate only where useful?
Final follow-up after stop: summarize PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED evidence and do not claim DONE_VERIFIED for the early no-code turns.
